cases.description: Regular shipping within the lowest weight tier (weight in (0, 1]) charges the base fee 5.
cases.input_strategy: Parametrize positive weights at/under 1kg, e.g. [0.1, 0.5, 1.0], express=False

cases.description: Weight of exactly 1kg is the inclusive upper boundary of the first tier and must yield 5, not 10.
cases.expected_behavior: Returns 5, confirming the first tier includes its 1kg boundary.

cases.description: Regular shipping within the middle tier (weight in (1, 5]) charges 10.
cases.expected_behavior: Returns 10 for every weight strictly above 1 up to and including 5.

cases.description: Weight exactly 5kg is the inclusive upper boundary of the middle tier and must yield 10, not 20.
cases.expected_behavior: Returns 10, confirming the middle tier includes its 5kg boundary.

cases.description: Regular shipping above 5kg falls into the highest tier and charges 20.
cases.expected_behavior: Returns 20 for every weight strictly greater than 5.

cases.description: Express surcharge of 8 is added to the base fee.
cases.input_strategy: Parametrize one representative weight per tier with express=True: [(0.5, 5), (3.0, 10), (7.0, 20)]

cases.description: Non-positive weights are rejected before any fee tier is computed.
cases.input_strategy: Parametrize zeros and negatives, e.g. [0, -0.001, -1, -100], with express both False and True
cases.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError with message 'weight must be positive'; no fee is returned.

cases.description: Zero weight is the exact threshold of the invalid guard and must raise rather than entering the first tier.
cases.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError, confirming the guard uses weight <= 0.
cases.setup: No setup; call shipping_fee with weight 0 and -0.0.

cases.description: The express argument defaults to False so the surcharge is not applied when omitted.
cases.input_strategy: Call shipping_fee(0.5) with no express argument and compare to shipping_fee(0.5, False)
cases.expected_behavior: Both calls return 5, confirming the default does not include the express surcharge.
cases.setup: No setup; rely on the default parameter value.
